spans.s: प्रति—हस्त m. a deputy, substitute, proxy. (-त्व n., Vcar.),
प्रति—हस्त—त्व n., Vcar.
प्रति—हस्तक (Hit.) m. a deputy, substitute, proxy.
प्रति—हस्ति ind. towards elephants, MBh.
प्रति—हस्तिन् m. the keeper of a brothel, Daś. (Sch. ‘a neighbour’).
प्रति—हृदयम् ind. in every heart, BhP., Sch.
put on or in &c.
&c. See प्रति-√ धा.
(आ), f. an arrow fitted to the bow-string, RV.; AV.
प्र॑ति-हि˚तेषु mfn. = ˚हितायिन्, Kauś.
प्रति-˚हितायि॑न् mfn. one who has adjusted the arrow, ŚBr.
प्रति-˚हिति f. adjusting an arrow, Kāṭh.
प्रति-˚हत mfn. struck or striking against, R.; Śak.; Rājat.
repelled, warded off, checked, impeded, obstructed, prevented, omitted, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
dazzled (as eyes i.e. impeded in their functions), BhP.
dulled, blunted (as teeth by acids = हृषित), L. (cf. Pat. on Pāṇ. vii, 2, 29)
hostile (cf. below)
disappointed, L.
hated, disliked, L.
tied, bound, L.
sent, despatched, L. (prob. w.r. for प्र-हित)
प्राति—हत m. a kind of Svarita accent, TPrāt.
प्रति-˚हत—धी mfn. hostile-minded, having hostile intentions, Bhartṛ.
प्रति-˚हत—मति mfn. id., W.
प्रति-˚हत—रय mfn. whose current is impeded, Megh.
प्रति-˚हति f. a stroke, blow, Bālar.
beating back, recoil, rebound, Śiś.
disappointment, W.
प्रति-˚हत्य ind. in inverse direction, Kauś.
प्रति-˚हनन n. impeding, suppressing, Yogas., Sch.
striking again, returning a blow, W.
प्रति-˚हन्तव्य mfn. to be opposed or resisted, MBh.; Hariv.
प्रति-˚हन्तृ m. one who wards off, preventer, Ragh. (v.l. ˚हर्तृ).

प्रति-√ हर्य् P. Ā. -ह॑र्यति, ˚ते, to desire, love, accept gladly, long for, RV.; AV.;
to despise, reject, AV.

प्रति-√ हा P. -जहाति, to leave unheeded, neglect, Hariv. :
Pass. -हीयते, to stay behind (abl.), be defeated, MBh.
प्रति-˚हान (?) cf. next.
a partic. Samādhi, Kāraṇḍ. (prob. w.r. for प्रतिहार-क्˚).
returning a laugh, laughing with or at, W.
fragrant oleander, Nerium Odorum, L.
प्रती—हास m. (cf. प्रति-ह्˚) Nerium Odorum, L.
retaliation, revenge, W.
प्रति-˚हिंसित mfn. injured in return
प्रति-˚हिंसित n. = prec. Pañcat.
प्रति-√ हु P. -जुहोति, to offer a supplementary sacrifice, Gobh.
प्रति-˚होतव्य mfn. to be offered as a supplementary s˚, ib., Sch.
प्रति-˚होम m. a supplementary sacrifice, Jaim.; Nyāyam.
throwing back, repelling, rejecting, AV.
avoiding, shunning, L.
प्रति-˚हर्तृ॑ m. (cf. प्रती-ह्˚) one who draws back or absorbs, a destroyer, MBh.
one who keeps or wards off, an averter, Ragh.
N. of one of the 16 priests (the assistant of the Udgātṛ), Br.; ŚrS. &c.
N. of a king (son of Pratihāra or of Pratīha), Pur.
प्रती—हर्तृ m. (cf. प्रति-ह्˚) a doorkeeper, porter, Rājat.
striking against, touch, contact (esp. of the tongue with the teeth in the pronunciation of the dentals), RPrāt.
shutting, closing, stopping (अ-प्र्˚), TāṇḍBr.
N. of partic. syllables in the Sāman hymns (with which the Pratihartṛ begins to join in singing, generally at the beginning of the last Pada of a stanza; also प्रती-ह्˚, AV.; ŚāṅkhBr.), Br.; ŚrS. &c.
N. of a partic. magical formula spoken over weapons, R. (v.l. ˚र-तर)
(that which keeps back), a door, gate (also प्रती-ह्˚, L.; cf. comp. below)
a door-keeper, porter, Hariv.; Kāv.; Pur. &c. (also प्रती-ह्˚; du. two d˚-k˚ i.e. two statues at the entrance of a temple, VarBṛS.; f(ई). a female d˚-k˚, portress, Priyad.)
a juggler, L.
juggling, trick, disguise, L.
प्रती—हार॑ m. (in most meanings) = प्रति-हार, q.v.
a partic. alliance, L. (w.r. for प्रती-कार above)
N. of a family of kings, Cat.
प्राति—हार m. a juggler, L.
प्रति-हार—गोप्त्री f. a female door-keeper, Vcar.
प्रति-हार—तर m. See above
प्रति-हार—प m. a door-keeper, BhP.
प्रति-हार—भूमि f. ‘d˚-place’, a threshold, Kum.
the office of a porter or a portress, Ragh.
प्रति-हार—रक्षी f. = -गोप्त्री, Vcar.
प्रति-हार—वत् mfn. containing the P˚ syllables (above), Lāṭy.
प्रति-हार—सूत्र n. N. of wk.
प्रति-˚हारक m. a juggler, L.
प्राति—हा˚रक m. id., L.
प्रति-˚हाराय Nom. to act as door-keeper (˚यितम् impers.), Prasannar.
प्रति-˚हार्य mfn. to be pushed back or repelled, resistible, R. (cf. अ-प्र्)
प्रति-˚हार्य n. jugglery, L.
N. of an Avadāna.
प्राति—हार्य n. (fr. -हार) the office of a door-keeper, Nalac.
jugglery, working miracles, a miracle, Lalit.; Kāraṇḍ.; Divyāv.
held back, ŚBr.
fastened, KātyŚr.

प्रति-√ हृष् Ā. -हृष्यते, to show joy in return for anything, MBh. :
Caus. हर्षयति, to gladden, rejoice, ib.
प्रति-˚हर्ष m. expression of joy, Dhātup.
प्रति-˚हर्षण mfn. (fr. Caus.) causing joy in return, R.
प्रति-√ हेष् Ā. -हेषते, to neigh towards (acc.), Var.
abbreviation, abridgment, ŚrS.
a slope, the rising vault (of the sky), RV.
प्रति-√ ह्वे Ā. -हुव॑ते, to call, RV.
प्रती—हार—ता f. (Rājat.) the office of a door keeper or chamberlain
प्रती—हार—त्व n. (Pañcat.) the office of a door keeper or chamberlain
प्रती—हार—धुरं-धरा f. a female door-keeper, Vcar.
प्रती—हारम् See प्रति-हृ.
प्राति—हन्त्र n. (fr. -हन्तृ) the state or condition of a revenger, vengeance, MW.
प्राति—हर्त्र n. the office or duty of the Pratihartṛ, KātyŚr.
प्राति—हा˚रिक mf(ई)n. containing pratihāras (as a Vedic hymn), Lāṭy.
प्राति—हा˚रिक m. a doorkeeper, Gaut.
a juggler, conjurer, L.
प्राति—हार्य—संदर्शन m. a partic. Samādhi, Kāraṇḍ.
